summary: Level-5's puzzle-adventure series starring Hershel Layton and later Katrielle Layton. The Ace Attorney crossover is tracked once under Ace Attorney to avoid a duplicate entry.

entries.title: Professor Layton and the Curious Village

emulation.notes: Primary is native Android/iOS. DS emulation is historical only.

primary.version: Professor Layton and the Curious Village: HD for Mobile
primary.why: The HD for Mobile release is the highest-fidelity official version, with remastered mobile presentation over the original DS release.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Android HD for Mobile release on a supported device or Android emulator; iOS HD is an equivalent official alternative.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use the DS original only for historical dual-screen feel or archival comparison.

entries.title: Professor Layton and the Last Specter

emulation.notes: DS emulation can improve capture scaling, but the content choice is the North American/Australian release.

primary.version: Last Specter with Professor Layton's London Life
primary.why: The North American and Australian DS versions include the large London Life RPG bonus, while the European Spectre's Call release removed it.
primary.how_to_play: Play the North American or Australian Nintendo DS version; for fidelity, use melonDS/DeSmuME with a legally dumped copy.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster; choose region carefully because London Life is not in every release.
